newsitem.title: INDIA: SBI, ITC drive Delhi shares to a higher close.
newsitem.headline: SBI, ITC drive Delhi shares to a higher close.

text.p: Delhi shares ended with modest gains as foreign institutional investors (FIIs) made selective purchases in State Bank of India (SBI) and ITC amid some short-covering by speculators, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index ended 2.62 points higher at 739.13.
They said trade in SBI shares was active as marketmen were awaiting an announcement regarding the price of the bank's proposed global depositary receipts (GDR) issue.
"Buyers and sellers preferred to keep their commitments at a low ebb as sentiment remained depressed," said Sumit Gandhi of brokers Rare Financial Services.
SBI ended 0.60 rupee higher at 263.05 while Reliance Industries was 1.50 rupees up at 197.10.
ITC gained 4.90 rupees to close at 298.40 and TISCO edged up 1.40 rupees to 173.95.
Larsen and Toubro closed 0.70 rupee higher at 242.20 while ACC ended 21 rupees higher at 1,876.
